AXES (as seen in the app's Front view): i = left->right (i=0 is the LEFT side, i=9 the RIGHT). j = depth (j=0 is the FRONT, nearest the viewer; j=9 is the BACK). k = height (k=0 rests on the ground, k=9 is the top).
CURRENT STATE: blocks 394, separate structures 1, floating blocks 0, longest cantilever 4 blocks (limit 4), over the limit 0; centre of gravity inside the base, margin 211 mm; peak joint stress 63% of allowable (0 blocks over 100%).
ISSUES: none.
